sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手煞费苦心地隐瞒了她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Since she was a little girl, Maria Cinque had always dreamed of starting a family of her own.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚·钦克奎从小就梦想着组建自己的家庭。

sentences.en: Her wish was fulfilled on June 11, 1971, when she gave birth to her first child, a boy named Giuseppe.
sentences.zh: 1971年6月11日，她的愿望实现了，她生下了第一个孩子，一个名叫朱塞佩的男孩。

sentences.en: He inherited his name from his grandfather, but was known to friends and family as Joe.
sentences.zh: 他继承了祖父的名字，但亲友们都叫他乔。

sentences.en: Maria and her husband Nino, who were both Italian immigrants, were besotted with Joe, describing him as the most beautiful baby they had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚和她的丈夫尼诺都是意大利移民，他们对乔疼爱有加，称他是他们见过最漂亮的孩子。

sentences.en: Four years later, Maria gave birth to their second child, a boy named Anthony.
sentences.zh: 四年后，玛丽亚生下了他们的第二个孩子，一个名叫安东尼的男孩。

sentences.en: The family of four lived in a neat two-storey red brick house in Newcastle, a harbour city on Australia's east coast, 160 kilometres north from Sydney.
sentences.zh: 这口四口之家住在纽卡斯尔一栋整洁的两层红砖房里。纽卡斯尔是澳大利亚东海岸的一个海港城市，位于悉尼以北160公里处。

sentences.en: Maria and Nino relished the constant buzz of activity their sons contributed around their household,
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚和尼诺很享受儿子们为家里带来的络绎不绝的活力，

sentences.en: and looked forward to each evening, when the family would gather for dinner at the kitchen table and share stories about their day.
sentences.zh: 并且盼望着每一个夜晚，全家人围坐在厨房的餐桌旁吃晚餐，分享各自一天的见闻。

sentences.en: The walls of the Cinque's home were adorned with family photos and trophies.
sentences.zh: 秦克一家的墙上挂满了家庭照片和奖杯。

sentences.en: Joe was a natural athlete and spent his school years playing every sport he could, including tennis, cricket and soccer.
sentences.zh: 乔是个天生的运动员，求学期间他参与了所能接触到的所有运动，包括网球、板球和足球。

sentences.en: He was popular amongst his classmates, well-liked by his teachers, and maintained good grades.
sentences.zh: 他在同学中很受欢迎，深受老师喜爱，并且成绩优异。

sentences.en: He intended to study architecture at university, but by the time he graduated from high school, he decided he didn't want a career that would keep him inside all day,
sentences.zh: 他原本打算在大学主修建筑学，但到高中毕业时，他觉得不想找一份整天把他关在室内的工作，

sentences.en: and switched to civil engineering instead.
sentences.zh: 于是转而学习土木工程。

sentences.en: In November 1994, at the age of 24, Joe completed his engineering degree and celebrated the milestone by travelling through Europe for two months.
sentences.zh: 1994年11月，24岁的乔完成了工程学学位，并以在欧洲旅游两个月的方式来庆祝这一人生里程碑。

sentences.en: Upon his return to Australia, he resumed living at home with his parents.
sentences.zh: 回到澳大利亚后，他搬回父母家同住。

sentences.en: He started work as a project manager for the same civil engineering company where his father
sentences.zh: 他在他父亲和祖父曾工作过的那家土木工程公司担任项目经理，

sentences.en: and grandfather were employed, earning a reputation as a hard-working and dependable person.
sentences.zh: 并赢得了勤奋可靠的好名声。

sentences.en: In his spare time, he played sports, went to the gym, and socialised, with people naturally drawn to his easygoing attitude and sense of humour.
sentences.zh: 闲暇时，他喜欢运动、去健身房和社交，人们自然而然地会被他随和的态度和幽默感所吸引。

sentences.en: At the beginning of 1995, Joe joined his mates for a night out at a club in town called The Brewery.
sentences.zh: 1995年年初，乔和朋友们一起去镇上一家名为“啤酒厂”的俱乐部过夜。

sentences.en: There, he met 22-year-old Anu Singh.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他遇到了22岁的阿努·辛格。

sentences.en: She had just completed a Bachelor of Economics at the Australian National University in Canberra and had returned to Newcastle to spend the summer with her family.
sentences.zh: 她刚刚在堪培拉的澳大利亚国立大学获得经济学学士学位，并回到纽卡斯尔与家人度过夏天。

sentences.en: Anu was born in the Punjab region of India, but had relocated to Australia with her parents when she was two years old.
sentences.zh: 阿努出生于印度的旁遮普地区，两岁时随父母移居澳大利亚。

sentences.en: Both her mother and father were medical practitioners, and Anu was the eldest of their two children.
sentences.zh: 她的父母都是医生，阿努是家中两个孩子的老大。

sentences.en: She was well-spoken, intelligent, and excelled academically, but was also known to behave questionably at times.
sentences.zh: 她谈吐得体、聪明伶俐、学业优秀，但有时也会做出一些令人起疑的行为。

sentences.en: Although she had a long-term boyfriend, Anu hit it off with Joe, and the pair commenced a romantic fling.
sentences.zh: 尽管她有一个长期男友，阿努还是和乔很合得来，两人开始了一段浪漫的恋情。

sentences.en: When she returned to Canberra, her boyfriend Simon found out about her infidelity and ended their relationship.
sentences.zh: 当她回到堪培拉时，她的男友西蒙发现了她的不忠并结束了他们的关系。

sentences.en: Following the breakup, Anu began seeing Joe again on a casual basis.
sentences.zh: 分手后，阿努开始以随意的关系再次与乔交往。

sentences.en: In mid-1996, they entered a long-distance relationship while Anu returned to study law at Canberra's Australian National University,
sentences.zh: 1996年中期，阿努回到堪培拉的澳大利亚国立大学继续攻读法律，两人开始了异地恋，

sentences.en: 450 kilometres south of Newcastle.
sentences.zh: 该校位于纽卡斯尔以南450公里处。

sentences.en: The couple initially kept their relationship a secret from Anu's parents, who wanted her to remain single while she completed her studies.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣最初对阿努的父母隐瞒了他们的恋情，她的父母希望她在完成学业期间保持单身。

sentences.en: Joe told his family that if the Sings ever called their house wanting to know who he was, they should say he was a friend of Anu's brother.
sentences.zh: 乔告诉家人，如果辛家打电话到家里来打听他的身份，他们就说他是阿努哥哥的朋友。

sentences.en: He was completely smitten with Anu and prioritised her above all else, racking up expensive phone bills by calling her up to 15 times a day.
sentences.zh: 他对阿努迷恋至极，把她放在一切之上，一天给她打多达15次电话，产生了巨额话费。

sentences.en: Every Friday afternoon, he made the five-and-a-half-hour drive to see her, returning home in the early hours of Monday morning to begin work at 9am.
sentences.zh: 每周五下午，他都要开车五个半小时去看她，并在周一清晨赶回家，上午9点开始工作。

sentences.en: Anu had several ongoing health problems, and if she was unwell, Joe would sometimes leave work in the middle of the week and fly to Canberra to take care of her.
sentences.zh: 阿努有一些长期的健康问题，如果她身体不舒服，乔有时会在周中离开工作，飞往堪培拉照顾她。

sentences.en: Maria and Nino Chinquay noticed a distinct change in their son's behaviour after he started dating Anu.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚和尼诺·钦凯发现，儿子开始与阿努交往后，他的行为发生了明显的变化。

sentences.en: According to the book Joe Chinquay's Consolation by Helen Garner,
sentences.zh: 根据海伦·加纳所著的书《乔·钦凯的安慰》，

sentences.en: Maria warned Joe not to let Anu control him, to which he replied,
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚警告乔不要让阿努控制他，对此他回答说：

sentences.en: Don't make me choose.
sentences.zh: 别逼我做选择。

sentences.en: I love you, but she needs me.
sentences.zh: 我爱你们，但她需要我。

sentences.en: In September 1996,
Joe permanently relocated to Canberra to live with Anu.
sentences.zh: 乔永久搬到了堪培拉，与阿努同住。

sentences.en: The couple moved into a semi-detached brick townhouse on the busy tree-lined thoroughfare Revantle Street in the suburb of Downer, four kilometres from Anu's university.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇搬进了位于道纳郊区繁华林荫大道雷万特尔街的一栋半独立砖砌联排别墅，距离阿努的大学四公里。

sentences.en: They had grand plans for their future and opened a joint bank account called Anu and Joe's Marriage Account.
sentences.zh: 他们对未来有着宏伟的规划，并开立了一个名为“阿努与乔的结婚账户”的联名银行账户。

sentences.en: In November, Anu finished her studies for the year and the couple spent three weeks in Newcastle staying with Joe's parents.
sentences.zh: 11月，阿努完成了当年的学业，这对夫妇在纽卡斯尔与乔的父母一起度过了三周。

sentences.en: Maria Chinquay described Anu as the perfect houseguest, but deep down, she had an instinctive feeling that Anu was not right for her son.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚·钦凯形容阿努是个完美的做客者，但在内心深处，她有一种直觉，觉得阿努并不适合她的儿子。

sentences.en: Before Anu entered a relationship with Joe, she had been left devastated by her breakup with Simon.
sentences.zh: 在阿努与乔交往之前，她曾因与西蒙的分手而心碎不已。

sentences.en: She was particularly hurt by a claim he made that she was, quote, intellectually inferior.
sentences.zh: 西蒙曾声称她“智力低下”，这让她尤其受到伤害。

sentences.en: The comment had a profound impact on the headstrong Anu, who had a tendency to look down on those she deemed stupid, and it marked a dramatic turning point in her behaviour.
sentences.zh: 这句话对性格倔强、倾向于看不起那些她认为愚蠢之人的阿努产生了深远的影响，这标志着她行为的一个戏剧性转折点。

sentences.en: She started experimenting with amphetamines and obsessed over her physical appearance, spending hours at the gym to maintain her figure.
sentences.zh: 她开始尝试使用安非他命，并对自己的外表产生执念，在健身房花上几个小时来保持身材。

sentences.en: By late 1995, Anu had developed bulimia, an eating disorder characterised by binge eating episodes, followed by self-induced vomiting, fasting,
sentences.zh: 到1995年底，阿努已经患上了贪食症，这是一种以暴食发作为特征的进食障碍，随后是自我催吐、禁食、

sentences.en: and the misuse of laxatives and diuretics.
sentences.zh: 以及滥用泻药和利尿剂。

sentences.en: She spiralled into a deep depression and moved back in with her parents, who were deeply concerned by her behaviour.
sentences.zh: 她陷入了深深的抑郁，搬回了父母家，她的父母对她的行为深感担忧。

sentences.en: She only consumed soft drinks and the occasional chocolate biscuit and begged her father to pay for her to get liposuction.
sentences.zh: 她只喝软饮料和偶尔吃一块巧克力饼干，并恳求父亲出钱让她做抽脂手术。

sentences.en: He encouraged her to seek professional help, but she refused to admit that she was suffering.
sentences.zh: 他鼓励她寻求专业帮助，但她拒绝承认自己生病了。

sentences.en: Joe was aware of the struggles Anu was facing and supported her wholeheartedly as a caretaking role came naturally to him.
sentences.zh: 乔知道阿努正在面对的挣扎，并全心全意地支持她，因为照顾人的角色对她来说是自然而然的。

sentences.en: When he was eight years old, his family was involved in a serious car accident.
sentences.zh: 在他八岁的时候，他的家庭遭遇了一场严重的车祸。

sentences.en: Maria suffered a debilitating foot injury and young Joe stepped up to help with the household chores.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚遭受了使她行动不便的足部受伤，年幼的乔挺身而出，帮忙分担家务。

sentences.en: Despite being told it was a doctor's responsibility to help Anu,
sentences.zh: 尽管被告知帮助阿努是医生的责任，

sentences.en: Joe continued to take care of her.
sentences.zh: 乔依然继续照顾她。

sentences.en: Calling her more than a dozen times per day, visiting her whenever she requested, and eventually moving to Canberra to live with her.
sentences.zh: 一天给她打十几次电话，只要她要求就去看她，最终搬到堪培拉和她一起生活。

sentences.en: With Joe by her side,
sentences.zh: 有乔陪伴在身边，

sentences.en: Anu's condition showed no signs of improvement.
sentences.zh: 阿努的病情没有丝毫好转的迹象。

sentences.en: By 1997, she became completely fixated on her health and complained about a range of physical symptoms, including aching legs, hot flushes, and chronic fatigue.
sentences.zh: 到1997年，她完全沉迷于自己的健康，并抱怨一系列身体症状，包括腿痛、潮热和慢性疲劳。

sentences.en: She withdrew from social events and rarely attended her university lectures.
sentences.zh: 她退出了社交活动，很少去上大学的课。

sentences.en: When she did, classmates noted she looked uncharacteristically dishevelled.
sentences.zh: 当她去上课时，同学们注意到她看起来一反常态地衣衫不整。

sentences.en: She told a friend there was something wrong with her metabolism and her muscles were being eaten away, but doctors couldn't find anything wrong
sentences.zh: 她告诉一个朋友，她的新陈代谢出了问题，肌肉正在被侵蚀，但医生却查不出问题所在，

sentences.en: and diagnosed her issues as purely psychological.
sentences.zh: 并诊断她的问题纯粹是心理问题。

sentences.en: Anu maintained there was nothing wrong with her mind and it was only her body that had probleMs.
sentences.zh: 阿努坚称她的精神没有任何问题，只有身体出了毛病。

sentences.en: At one stage, her mother found her frantically pacing her room in tears, saying things were crawling under her skin and it felt like her head was attached to someone else's body.
sentences.zh: 有一次，她母亲发现她在房间里焦急地踱步，泪流满面，说有什么东西在皮肤下爬行，感觉自己的头好像接在别人的身体上。

sentences.en: Following this incident,
sentences.zh: 这件事发生后，

sentences.en: Anu agreed to see a psychiatrist who referred her to another doctor, but she never followed through with the appointment.
sentences.zh: 阿努同意去看精神科医生，医生把她转诊给另一位医生，但她从未去赴约。

sentences.en: In March 1997,
Anu approached Maria Chinque, hoping she would understand her ongoing health issues, given Maria's own experience following the car accident.
sentences.zh: 阿努找到玛丽亚·钦格，希望她能理解自己持续的健康问题，因为玛丽亚自己也有过车祸后的经历。

sentences.en: Anu was anxiously pacing and fidgeting, leading Maria to wonder whether she was going through drug withdrawals.
sentences.zh: 阿努焦虑地踱步、坐立不安，这让玛丽亚怀疑她是否在经历戒毒反应。

sentences.en: Months later,
sentences.zh: 几个月后，

sentences.en: Anu was convinced she had contracted AIDS.
sentences.zh: 阿努坚信自己感染了艾滋病。

sentences.en: She told a friend it was unfair that Joe was unaffected by the disease and that she planned to put her infected blood on his toothbrush.
sentences.zh: 她对一个朋友说，乔没有被这种疾病影响是不公平的，她打算把带病毒的血抹在他的牙刷上。

sentences.en: When the results of her AIDS test came back negative,
sentences.zh: 当艾滋病检测结果呈阴性时，

sentences.en: Anu considered the possibility that she had a crippling nervous system condition like multiple sclerosis or peripheral neuropathy.
sentences.zh: 阿努开始考虑自己是否患有致残性神经系统疾病，比如多发性硬化症或周围神经病变。

sentences.en: She showered up to seven times a day and told her father that she thought she was going to die.
sentences.zh: 她一天洗多达七次澡，并告诉父亲她觉得自己快要死了。

sentences.en: Her mother contacted a mental health crisis team and tried to have Anu admitted for treatment, but as she wasn't considered a danger to herself or others,
sentences.zh: 她的母亲联系了心理健康危机干预团队，试图让阿努入院治疗，但由于她不被认为对自己或他人构成危险，

sentences.en: they couldn't admit her without her permission.
sentences.zh: 他们在没有她允许的情况下无法让她入院。

sentences.en: Anu blamed her undiagnosed condition on Ipacac syrup, a vomit-inducing medication.
sentences.zh: 阿努将她未确诊的病情归咎于吐根糖浆，这是一种催吐药物。

sentences.en: Joe had once mentioned it during a conversation about how supermodels were able to control their appetites.
sentences.zh: 乔曾在一次讨论超模如何控制食欲时提到过它。

sentences.en: Although he refused to talk to her about it any further, she resented him for inadvertently introducing her to the medication, which she used to maintain her weight.
sentences.zh: 尽管他拒绝再和她谈论此事，但她还是怨恨他无意中向她介绍了这种药，她用它来维持体重。

sentences.en: In late May, Anu told a friend she hated Joe and wanted to go on a rampage to kill him, her ex-boyfriend Simon, and all the incompetent doctors she had seen.
sentences.zh: 5月下旬，阿努对一个朋友说，她恨乔，想要大开杀戒，杀了他、她的前男友西蒙以及她看过的所有庸医。

sentences.en: She added, quote,
sentences.zh: 她接着说道：

sentences.en: I studied psychiatric text and it wouldn't be too hard to convince someone you're insane.
sentences.zh: 我研究过精神病学文本，要让别人相信你疯了其实并不难。

sentences.en: The next month, she visited Canberra's National Library with her closest friend, fellow law student Madhavi Rao.
sentences.zh: 第二个月，她和最要好的朋友、同为法学生的玛达维·拉奥一起参观了堪培拉的国家图书馆。

sentences.en: Like Anu,
sentences.zh: 和阿努一样，

sentences.en: Madhavi had high-achieving Indian parents and excelled academically, but was the quieter, more studious of the pair.
sentences.zh: 玛达维有着成就很高的印度父母，学业优异，但两人中她更安静、更好学。

sentences.en: They sourced a book written by the Hemlock Society, an American organisation that advocated an individual's right to die.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了一本由铁杉协会编写的书，这是一个主张个人安乐死权利的美国组织。

sentences.en: It contained information on assisted suicide and relevant legislation surrounding the issue, and the pair photocopied various pages.
sentences.zh: 里面包含了关于协助自杀的信息以及与该问题相关的立法，两人复印了不同的页面。

sentences.en: A month later,
sentences.zh: 一个月后，

sentences.en: Anu asked a friend if he could help her obtain a gun, telling him she was suffering from permanent neurological damage and wanted to end her life.
sentences.zh: 阿努问一个朋友能不能帮她弄一把枪，告诉他自己患有永久性神经损伤，想要结束生命。

sentences.en: A week later, the same friend spotted Anu sitting in her car in the city and she told him she was trying to buy a gun.
sentences.zh: 一周后，同一个朋友在城里看到阿努坐在车里，她告诉他她正在试图买枪。

sentences.en: Thinking she was joking, he playfully warned her she was going to get ripped off.
sentences.zh: 以为她在开玩笑，他半开玩笑地警告她她会被狠宰一笔的。

sentences.en: Shortly after,
sentences.zh: 不久之后，

sentences.en: Anu told another classmate that she was sick and wanted to die.
sentences.zh: 阿努告诉另一个同学她生病了，想死。

sentences.en: She had been studying methods of suicide and decided a gunshot wound was preferable and asked for help to buy a firearm.
sentences.zh: 她一直在研究自杀方法，认为枪伤是更好的选择，并请求帮忙买一把枪。

sentences.en: Her classmate thought their conversation was, quote, too silly for words and didn't think she was being serious, even when she phoned him days later
sentences.zh: 她的同学认为他们的谈话简直荒谬至极，根本不相信她是认真的，甚至几天后她打电话过来时也是如此

sentences.en: asking if he had any luck getting one.
sentences.zh: 问他有没有运气弄到一把。

sentences.en: That same month,
sentences.zh: 就在那个月，

sentences.zh: 阿努向另一个熟人讲述了她计划用枪结束生命的打算。

sentences.en: They advised that an intentional heroin overdose would be a much better way to die.
sentences.zh: 他们建议说，刻意过量注射海洛因会是一种好得多的死法。

sentences.en: Anu organised to sell a large collection of her clothes at one or two dollars per item, telling her father she no longer needed them as she never went out.
sentences.zh: 阿努安排以一两美元一件的价格出售她的一大批衣服，并告诉父亲她不再需要它们了，因为她从不出门。

sentences.en: She also started giving away her CDs, claiming she no longer listened to them.
sentences.zh: 她还开始送出她的CD，声称她不再听了。

sentences.en: Her parents reached out to the mental health crisis team again, this time submitting an application to have Anu hospitalised against her will.
sentences.zh: 她的父母再次联系了心理健康危机干预团队，这次提交了一份申请，要求违背阿努的意愿将她住院治疗。

sentences.en: But before any action could be taken, the application had to be approved by a magistrate and it was scheduled for review in due course.
sentences.zh: 但在采取任何行动之前，该申请必须得到治安法官的批准，并定于适时进行审查。

sentences.en: Anu inquired with a known drug user on campus about the logistics of overdosing on heroin.
sentences.zh: 阿努向校园里的一个知名吸毒者打听过量注射海洛因的具体细节。

sentences.en: He explained that in excess quantities, heroin causes a user to stop breathing and die a painless death within minutes.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，过量的海洛因会导致吸毒者停止呼吸，并在几分钟内无痛死亡。

sentences.en: He believed $150 worth of the illicit substance would be enough to cause a recreational user to overdose.
sentences.zh: 他认为价值150美元的违禁物质就足以让一个娱乐性吸毒者过量。

sentences.en: A week later, Anu called him wanting to buy half a gram of heroin.
sentences.zh: 一周后，阿努打电话给他，想要买半克海洛因。

sentences.en: She arrived at his house with her friend Madhavi soon after and exchanged $250 for the drug.
sentences.zh: 不久后，她和朋友玛达维一起来到他家，用250美元交换了毒品。

sentences.en: The two women were shown how to prepare a hit and were both injected for the first time.
sentences.zh: 这两个女人被演示了如何准备毒资，并且两人的第一次注射都是在那里进行的。

sentences.en: A month later, they attempted to shoot up on their own but couldn't find the right veins, so they invited another of their friends over to re-demonstrate the injection process.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，她们尝试自己注射，但找不到正确的静脉，于是她们邀请了另一个朋友过来重新演示注射过程。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, September 23,
sentences.zh: 9月23日，星期二，

sentences.en: Anu made an appointment with a university counsellor to discuss her relationship with Joe Ching-Kwe.
sentences.zh: 阿努与学校辅导员预约，讨论她与乔·青奎的关系。

sentences.en: She divulged that the two were verbally and physically abusive to one another and she wanted to end the relationship but couldn't as her medical condition meant she was financially
sentences.zh: 她透露，两人在言语和身体上互相虐待，她想结束这段关系，但又做不到，因为她的病情意味着她在财务

sentences.en: and emotionally dependent on him.
sentences.zh: 和情感上都依赖他。

sentences.en: Weeks later,
sentences.zh: 几周后，

sentences.zh: 阿努又买了一克海洛因。

sentences.zh: 毒贩质问她为什么需要这么多，阿努回答说：

sentences.en: someone's coming with me.
sentences.zh: 有人要跟我一起去。

sentences.en: When asked if she intended to end her own life,
sentences.zh: 当被问及她是否打算结束自己的生命时，

sentences.zh: 阿努说是的，但拒绝透露她自杀契约中的另一个人是谁。

sentences.en: On Sunday, October 19,
sentences.zh: 10月19日，星期日，

sentences.en: Joe visited his parents in Newcastle and told them he and Anu were hosting a dinner party the following evening.
sentences.zh: 乔去纽卡斯尔看望父母，告诉他们他和阿努将在第二天晚上举办晚宴。

sentences.en: He asked if his mother had any meals prepared that he could serve his guests.
sentences.zh: 他问他母亲有没有准备什么饭菜可以端给他的客人吃。

sentences.en: Maria offered to cook something up but Joe told her not to worry about it and decided to pick up some fried chicken instead.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚主动提出做点什么，但乔叫她不用担心，决定去买点炸鸡代替。

sentences.en: The dinner party went ahead on Monday, October 20.
sentences.zh: 晚宴如期在10月20日星期一举行。

sentences.en: Madhavi was invited and brought along another friend, Olivia, who had never met Joe or Anu before.
sentences.zh: 玛达维应邀出席，并带了另一个朋友奥利维娅，她从未见过乔或阿努。

sentences.en: Prior to the dinner,
sentences.zh: 晚宴之前，

sentences.en: Madhavi showed Olivia a needle mark in her arm, explaining that Anu had been injecting her with heroin to practice for her own suicide.
sentences.zh: 玛达维向奥利维娅展示了她手臂上的一个针眼，解释说阿努一直在给她注射海洛因，以为自己的自杀做练习。

sentences.en: She revealed that the dinner was a final send-off as Anu was planning to end her and Joe's lives that night.
sentences.zh: 她透露，这次晚宴是一场最后的欢送会，因为阿努计划那天晚上结束她和乔的生命。

sentences.en: When the two women arrived at the Antle Street townhouse,
sentences.zh: 当这两个女人到达安特尔街的联排别墅时，

sentences.en: Anu told them she had prepared way more food than was necessary for their small group of guests.
sentences.zh: 阿努告诉她们，她准备的食物远超他们这几个小群体客人所需的量。

sentences.en: The suburb they lived in was home to many other university students so she told Madhavi and Olivia to doorknock the area to see if anyone else wanted to join them.
sentences.zh: 他们住的郊区居住了许多其他大学生，所以她让玛达维和奥利维娅去该地区敲门，看看有没有其他人想加入他们。

sentences.en: By then, rumours of Anu's intentions had spread, spurring other students, some of whom were total strangers, to attend to the party out of morbid curiosity.
sentences.zh: 当时，关于阿努意图的谣言已经传开，吸引了其他学生，其中一些人完全是陌生人，出于病态的好奇心前来参加派对。

sentences.en: Anu acted loving and happy towards her boyfriend and didn't appear suicidal, leading the group to suspect her plan had never been serious.
sentences.zh: 阿努对她的男友表现得深情而快乐，看起来并不想自杀，这让大家怀疑她的计划从来都不是认真的。

sentences.en: The party ended without incident.
sentences.zh: 派对平安结束。

sentences.en: Madhavi drove several of the guests home, telling them the suicide plot was going ahead later that night.
sentences.zh: 玛达维开车送几位客人回家，告诉他们自杀计划将在那天晚些时候进行。

sentences.en: Her passengers asked if they should seek medical help, but Madhavi ordered them not to do a thing.
sentences.zh: 她的乘客问他们是否应该寻求医疗帮助，但玛达维命令他们什么也不要做。

sentences.en: They were still uncertain if the entire scenario was a joke, but ultimately decided that it was Anu's choice if she wanted to end her own life and doctored not to get involved.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然不确定整个计划是否只是一个玩笑，但最终认为，阿努如果想结束自己的生命那是她自己的选择，并决定不予干涉。

sentences.en: Meanwhile,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Anu had crushed some sedatives and sprinkled them into Joe's drink, causing him to drift off to sleep.
sentences.zh: 阿努碾碎了一些镇静剂，将它们撒进乔的饮料中，导致他沉沉睡去。

sentences.en: She then fetched a pre-prepared syringe full of heroin and tried to inject it into him, but he was restless and she struggled to find the right vein.
sentences.zh: 随后，她拿来一支预先准备好的装满海洛因的注射器，试图给他注射，但他一直烦躁不安，她很难找到合适的静脉。

sentences.en: The liquid congealed, rendering it useless.
sentences.zh: 液体凝固了，导致它无法使用。

sentences.en: Joe woke up the following morning and went to work, seemingly unaware of what Anu had attempted the night before.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，乔醒来去上班了，似乎并不知道阿努前一天晚上曾企图对她做什么。

sentences.en: Anu contacted Madhavi and told her what she had done.
sentences.zh: 阿努联系了玛达维，并将她所做的事告诉了她。

sentences.en: The day after the dinner party,
sentences.zh: 晚宴后的第二天，

sentences.zh: 玛达维去了社区与健康服务投诉委员会，她在那里为自己的法律学位进行实习工作。

sentences.en: She told two colleagues that something really serious had happened the night before and was paranoid the police were after her.
sentences.zh: 她告诉两位同事，前一晚发生了一件非常严重的事情，并且由于偏执，她觉得警察在追捕她。

sentences.en: When they asked what had happened,
sentences.zh: 当他们问发生了什么事时，

sentences.en: Madhavi told them it was, quote,
sentences.zh: 玛达维告诉他们，原话是，

sentences.zh: 世纪大案。

sentences.en: It's got to do with revenge.
sentences.zh: 这与复仇有关。

sentences.en: It's the worst thing in the Crimes Act.
sentences.zh: 这是《刑法》中最严重的罪行。

sentences.zh: 在她第一次谋杀乔失败后，

sentences.zh: 阿努让她的一个海洛因吸食者朋友去寻找氟硝西泮（Rehypnol），这是一种药效比安定强近10倍的镇静药物。

sentences.en: The sedative was often prescribed to help overcome heroin addiction and the friend had no problem obtaining a prescription from her general practitioner.
sentences.zh: 这种镇静剂通常被用来帮助克服海洛因成瘾，这位朋友轻而易举地从她的全科医生那里开到了处方。

sentences.en: Anu obtained 15 Rehypnol tablets and was told that when paired with heroin, only one tablet was needed to render a person unconscious.
sentences.zh: 阿努弄到了15片氟硝西泮，并被告知当与海洛因配合使用时，只需一片就能让一个人失去知觉。

sentences.zh: 档案案卷稍后回归。

sentences.zh: 在乔不知情的情况下，

sentences.zh: 阿努安排了10月24日星期五晚上的第二次晚宴，她再次告诉客人们，她打算随后带着她和乔一起结束生命。

sentences.en: When the evening arrived,
sentences.zh: 当夜晚来临的时候，

sentences.en: Joe returned home from work to discover his house was filled with people.
sentences.zh: 乔下班回家，发现屋里挤满了人。

sentences.en: Although he seemed surprised, he was a gracious and sociable host, welcoming guests and speaking excitedly about his new car and upcoming plans to holiday in Queensland.
sentences.zh: 尽管他显得有些惊讶，但他仍是一个亲切随和的主人，热情欢迎客人们，并兴奋地谈论着他的新车以及即将到昆士兰度假的计划。

sentences.en: There were mixed reactions among the guests.
sentences.zh: 客人们的反应不一。

sentences.en: Martavi had told her friend Olivia that the suicide plot was going ahead for real this time.
sentences.zh: 玛塔维曾告诉她的朋友奥利维亚，自杀阴谋这次要来真的了。

sentences.en: But Olivia dismissed her by saying,
sentences.zh: 但奥利维亚不以为然地反驳说，

sentences.en: people who are going to do this sort of thing don't just talk about it, they go ahead and do it.
sentences.zh: 打算做这种事的人才不会只是说说而已，他们会直接付诸行动。

sentences.en: But Martavi was certain, telling colleagues and classmates beforehand that there was nothing she could do to stop it.
sentences.zh: 但玛塔维确信不疑，她事先对同事和同学说，她对此无能为力，无法阻止。

sentences.en: Another guest thought the story was so absurd that it couldn't possibly be true, while others wrote it off as another of Anu's dramatic attention-seeking stories.
sentences.zh: 另一位客人觉得这个故事太荒谬了，根本不可能是真的，而其他人则认为这只是阿努又一次为了博取关注而自导自演的闹剧。

sentences.en: They showed up regardless, curious to see what would unfold.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们还是出现了，好奇地想看看事情会如何发展。

sentences.en: Joe was happy and affectionate towards Anu, who was noticeably vivacious and bubbly.
sentences.zh: 乔对阿努表现得既高兴又亲昵，而阿努则显得格外活泼开朗。

sentences.en: When a friend inquired about her good mood,
sentences.zh: 当有朋友询问她为什么心情这么好时，

sentences.en: Anu said she had consumed a few drinks and taken some rehypnol.
sentences.zh: 阿努说她喝了几杯酒，还吃了一些氟硝西泮。

sentences.en: The party continued without incident into the early hours.
sentences.zh: 派对在平静中持续到了凌晨。

sentences.en: The group discussed plans to visit a casino, but the idea didn't go ahead and people started heading home.
sentences.zh: 大家讨论了去赌场游玩的计划，但这个想法没有实施，人们开始陆续回家。

sentences.en: Eventually, everyone left, except Martavi.
sentences.zh: 最终，除了玛塔维，所有人都离开了。

sentences.en: At six the following morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上六点，

sentences.zh: 玛塔维回到家，告诉一个在那里过夜的朋友，阿努在乔的咖啡里放了十片氟硝西泮，并试图给他注射致死剂量的海洛因。

sentences.en: She explained, quote,
sentences.zh: 她解释道，原话是，

sentences.zh: 没成功。

sentences.en: It's amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太神奇了。

sentences.en: It wasn't his time to go.
sentences.zh: 还没到他走的时候。

sentences.en: When asked why Anu was trying to hurt Joe,
sentences.zh: 当被问及为什么阿努要伤害乔时，

sentences.en: Martavi stated,
sentences.zh: 玛塔维表示，

sentences.en: Joe's the problem.
sentences.zh: 乔才是问题所在。

sentences.en: She wants to take Joe with her.
sentences.zh: 她想带乔一起走。

sentences.en: It's because she blames him for her condition.
sentences.zh: 这是因为她把自己的病情怪罪于他。

sentences.en: After consulting with her friend,
sentences.zh: 在与朋友商量之后，

sentences.en: Martavi decided she wasn't going to have any further involvement in Anu's plan.
sentences.zh: 玛塔维决定不再进一步参与阿努的计划。

sentences.en: As the day continued, word of Anu's persistent efforts to kill Joe spread throughout their friendship circle.
sentences.zh: 随着白天的推移，关于阿努坚持不懈试图杀死乔的消息在他们的朋友圈中传开了。

sentences.en: One friend threatened to contact the police, but Anu found out and talked her out of it, reassuring she would never do anything to hurt Joe, saying,
sentences.zh: 一个朋友威胁要报警，但阿努知道了并劝说她打消了这个念头，向她保证自己绝不会做任何伤害乔的事，并说道：

sentences.en: We're engaged to be married.
sentences.zh: 我们已经订婚了。

sentences.en: You could ruin this for all of us.
sentences.zh: 你可能会把我们所有人的事都毁了。

sentences.en: Anu had a flair for drama and many of her friends were familiar with her grandiose stories of illness and suicide.
sentences.zh: 阿努很有戏剧表演的天赋，她的许多朋友都很熟悉她那些关于疾病和自杀的夸大其词的故事。

sentences.en: But as she had never gone through with self-harm, most remained convinced this was just another of her telltales.
sentences.zh: 但由于她从未真正付诸过自残行动，大多数人仍然坚信这只是她又一次危言耸听的谎言。

sentences.en: Anu admitted to those concerned that she had given Joe three rehypnol tablets, but insisted it was only to make sure he was asleep while she ended her own life.
sentences.zh: 阿努向那些关心她的人承认，她给乔服用了三片氟硝西泮，但坚称这只是为了确保他在她结束自己生命时处于睡眠状态。

sentences.en: She convinced them that Joe was not in any danger and that she was going to confess to him about spiking his drink.
sentences.zh: 她让大家相信乔没有面临任何危险，而且她打算向他坦白在饮料里下药的事。

sentences.en: In turn, the others agreed to let it go.
sentences.zh: 反过来，其他人也同意不再追究。

sentences.en: At 10.19 that evening,
sentences.zh: 当晚10点19分，

sentences.zh: 阿努打电话给一位名叫兰的朋友，他曾出席过第二次晚宴。

sentences.zh: 兰对阿努不怀好意的计划心知肚明，但他认为整个故事只是一种博取关注的呼喊，以此打消了其他人的顾虑。

sentences.zh: 他的答录机记录了他们部分对话，当时阿努询问氟硝西泮的药效有多强。

sentences.zh: 她解释说，乔已经连续睡了大约15个小时，现在昏昏沉沉的，连眼睛都快睁不开了。

sentences.en: She was worried about what she had done, but Len reassured her that she wouldn't have caused any long-term damage.
sentences.zh: 她对自己的所作所为感到担忧，但兰安慰她说，她不会造成任何长期的损害。

sentences.zh: 接着，乔从女友手里接过电话对兰说：

sentences.zh: 嘿，兄弟，我的大脑100%正常运转，我的身体只是想疯狂地睡觉，仅此而已。

sentences.zh: 午夜刚过不久，

sentences.en: The following morning of Sunday,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的星期天早晨，

Anu visited Madhavi and told her that Joe wasn't breathing and she needed money to buy heroin to take her own life.

sentences.zh: 两人开车去了一台自动取款机，玛达维给了阿努250美元现金，随后独自步行回家。

sentences.en: At 9am,
sentences.zh: 早上9点，

sentences.zh: 阿努来到她的毒贩家，买半克海洛因。

sentences.en: While it was being prepared in a syringe for her, she paced back and forth, repeatedly saying,
sentences.zh: 当毒贩在注射器里为她准备时，她在房间里来回踱步，不停地说：
